drafted_from: tools/check-every-screen-at-every-width/check-live-screens.mjs, held-session.mjs and tool-rows.json (tool:check-live-screens-signed-in, group 9); run on the Mac Nov 21 2026 (runs a41cdad3, 31ddb68f)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Check my workspace's Record screen signed in, on a phone and a desktop." It runs tool:check-live-screens-signed-in with sign_in {kind: 'held-session'} on each page.
no_lists_because: Its only state is vault values (proof-sessions, proof-sign-in-code), never rows; the proof accounts are the Workshop DATA proof-accounts.json.
instructions: 1. The vault holds proof-sessions with a session for each page's origin; workflow:keep-the-proof-sessions-signed-in keeps it fresh.
2. Give pages as {id, url, sign_in: {kind: 'held-session'}, ready?, reach?, taps?} and views.

3. Read per page and view: status, first_paint_ms, first_contentful_paint_ms (on the document the page lands on), usable_ms, blank_ms, documents (the addresses a sign-in hop went through), errors, failed requests and a picture in your Files under /live-screens/<run>/.
4. An origin the session does not hold refuses the run before a browser starts.
